relations.subject: Fritz Graebner
relations.evidence: In 1901 he re- ceived his doctorate in philosophy at Berlin with a dissertation on medieval history.

relations.subject: Fritz Graebner
relations.evidence: By this time he was already employed at the Berlin Museum of Ethnology as an auxiliary scientific assistant. In 1906 he transferred to the museum of ethnology in Cologne

relations.subject: Fritz Graebner
relations.evidence: In 1906 he transferred to the museum of ethnology in Cologne (called the Rautenstrauch-Joest Museum after those who endowed it), became a full assistant there in 1907, and the museum's director in 1925.

relations.subject: Fritz Graebner
relations.evidence: and the museum's director in 1925. ... He retired in 1928

relations.subject: Fritz Graebner
relations.evidence: In 1911 he qualified as a pri- vatdocent at the University of Bonn.

relations.subject: Fritz Graebner
relations.evidence: In 1921 he was appointed professor extraordinarius at Bonn

relations.subject: Fritz Graebner
relations.evidence: in 1926 became an honorary professor at the Uni- versity of Cologne. However, he was unable by this time to lecture any longer ... He retired in 1928
